query: 供应商申诉机制 供应商申诉机制 衡量企业为供应商提供的正式沟通与举报渠道。重点考察申诉渠道的独立性、匿名保护能力、反报复政策、处理时限以及重大争议的升级处理机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：设有独立的第三方举报平台或由审计/合规部门直管的匿名渠道；具备书面的《供应商反报复政策》；明确了申诉处理的时限（如 15 个工作日内给予实质性答复）；并有高级管理层参与的争议调解与升级路径。 • 1分（合格）：提供了采购部门外的申诉联系方式（如廉洁邮箱、热线），有基础的受理与记录流程，但缺乏第三方独立性、具体的处理时限承诺或系统性的反报复保护细则。 • 0分（不合格）：无针对供应商的正式申诉渠道披露，或仅提供采购员个人联系方式。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：申诉机制覆盖 >80% 的供应商（按采购额或数量计），且在供应商系统（SRM）、合同附件或年度供应商大会中进行了明确告知。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心供应商知晓该渠道，或未披露具体告知与覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 供应商申诉机制 供应商举报 供应商诉说渠道 供应商反报复 采购廉洁热线 供应商争议升级 SRM supplier grievance mechanism supplier whistleblowing supplier speak-up anti-retaliation for suppliers procurement integrity hotline supplier dispute escalation SRM 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '供应商申诉机制'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 供应商可用的正式申诉/举报渠道有哪些？ 是否独立于采购员个人联系方式并支持匿名？ 是否有书面反报复政策与处理时限？ 重大争议如何升级到高层？ 机制覆盖多少供应商，是否告知供应商？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有员工申诉热线；仅有采购员微信/电话；仅有供应商行为准则而无申诉入口；仅有客户投诉渠道；区分：供应商申诉机制服务供应商；员工申诉服务员工；举报人保护偏内部舞弊举报；有行为准则不等于已建立供应商可及申诉渠道。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

[Content]
In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

results.text: An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.

[Content]
An effective supply chain management is critical for our business. Air freight as well as ocean freight services involve various vendors including airline companies, shipping line companies, carriers, co-loaders, transportation companies and related business agents. The Group values its relationships with suppliers and puts in efforts to maintain long-term and stable business relations. A Vendor Committee is formed by the top management team, corporate function heads, stations management heads and departmental management heads, to oversee and ensure smooth vendor selection and appointment. Our Vendor Management Policy offers guidelines on procurement of services and products from third parties.

results.text: The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.

results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.
